pages.text: Alex's Mobs adds over 80 real-world and fantastical creatures to the world — from bald eagles and grizzly bears to void worms and laviathans. Most are passive or neutral, but several are powerful hunters.

$(bold)Notable creatures:$() The $(bold)Void Worm$() (end boss), $(bold)Cachalot Whale$() (ocean), $(bold)Laviathan$() (sky), and $(bold)Murmur$() (underground) are boss-tier encounters. Most creatures drop unique materials used in Apotheosis gem crafting.$(br2)$(bold)IridescentCraft interactions:$() Several Alex's Mobs creatures appear in boss loot tables and drop tokens.
Craft the $(bold)Animal Dictionary$() for a full bestiary — every creature, its drops, its habitat, and any tameable/rideable behavior.
